title.original: Ragged Paged Attention: A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU
title.zh: 非等长分页注意力：面向 TPU 的高性能灵活 LLM 推理内核
title.en: Ragged Paged Attention: A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU

inclusion_reason.zh: RPA 提供面向 TPU 的非等长分页注意力 kernel、分布特化编译和 vLLM/SGLang 集成，是生产推理后端。
inclusion_reason.en: RPA supplies a ragged paged-attention kernel, distribution-specialized compilation, and vLLM/SGLang integration for TPU, making it a production inference backend.

abstract.zh: Ragged Paged Attention 用 Pallas/Mosaic 为 TPU 实现动态非等长分页注意力，通过细粒度 tile、KV 更新融合和按工作负载分布特化的编译覆盖 decode、prefill 与混合流量。
abstract.en: Ragged Paged Attention implements dynamic paged attention for TPU in Pallas and Mosaic, combining fine-grained tiling, fused KV updates, and distribution-specialized compilation for decode, prefill, and mixed traffic.

problem.zh: 主流注意力 kernel 以 GPU 为中心，难映射 TPU 的存储和执行模型，尤其不能高效处理服务中的非等长序列与动态分页。
problem.en: Most attention kernels are GPU-centric and map poorly to TPU memory and execution, particularly for ragged sequences and dynamic paging in serving.

approach.zh: RPA 用细粒度 tile 支持动态切片，软件流水线把 KV 缓存更新与注意力融合，并根据线上长度分布生成不同阶段的特化 kernel。
approach.en: RPA uses fine-grained tiles for dynamic slicing, a software pipeline that fuses KV-cache updates with attention, and workload-distribution-aware compilation for specialized phase kernels.

system_design.zh: 分页元数据驱动 Pallas tile 读取非等长 KV，流水线交错更新和计算；编译器依据 decode/prefill 分布选取特化版本，并作为 vLLM 与 SGLang 的 TPU 后端。
system_design.en: Paged metadata drives Pallas tiles over ragged KV, the pipeline interleaves updates and computation, and the compiler selects decode/prefill specializations integrated as TPU backends for vLLM and SGLang.

key_results.zh: TPU7x 上 RPA 在 decode 和 prefill 都达到较高硬件利用率，并已作为两个主流推理服务框架的主要 TPU 路径。
key_results.en: On TPU7x, RPA reaches high hardware utilization in both decode and prefill and serves as a primary TPU path in two major inference frameworks.

limitations.zh: 实现深度绑定 TPU 编译栈，分布特化在流量漂移时可能需要重新编译；对其他模型、量化和多租户干扰的覆盖仍有限。
limitations.en: The implementation is tied closely to the TPU compiler stack, distribution specialization may require recompilation under traffic drift, and coverage of other models, quantization, and multi-tenant interference is limited.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
